lastResponse.text: Yes, and fastest step right now is call two one one and ask the live agent for an open warming center in Old Town tonight. I only have centers listed outside Portland: La Grande at 501 third Street and Bend at 275 Northeast second Street. If you feel unsafe leaving that 7‑Eleven, call nine one one now and say you were threatened and need a safe indoor Place tonight.
